installation_summary: Installed EAM-Portal Bund (Next.js 15.3.0 static-export app) in `/workspace`. Node.js was not present in the environment; I installed Node.js v22.11.0 (matching the guide's Node.js 22 prerequisite) from the official nodejs.org binary tarball to `/opt/node-v22.11.0-linux-x64` and symlinked `node`, `npm`, `npx` into `/usr/local/bin`. Then ran the documented workflow: `npm ci` (382 packages installed, exit 0), `npm run lint` (no ESLint warnings/errors, exit 0), `npm run build` (compiled successfully, static export produced in `/workspace/out/`, exit 0). Started `npm run dev` and confirmed the app serves at http://localhost:3000 with HTTP 200. Final method: the documented guide steps run under the newly installed Node 22. No abandoned alternatives.
